test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, name the head of Instagram who oversees all functions of the business including engineering, production and operations.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adam Mosseri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adam Mosseri **is the **head of Instagram**, where he is in charge of engineering, product, and operations.
 
• Adam is known for combining sharp design thinking with careful product strategy to build experiences that bring people together and inspire genuine connections.
 
• He worked as a **design director for Facebook's mobile apps** before moving into product management and leading the News Feed product and technical teams for several years.
 
• Prior to joining Instagram, he was the Head of News Feed, where he supervised products until eventually becoming the CEO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ronald Gerald Wayne **is a retired businessman from the electronics industry in the United States. On April 1, 1976, he co-founded Apple Computer Company with Steve Wozniak and Steve Jobs, providing administrative control and paperwork for the fledgling company.
 
• **Stephen Gary Wozniak **co-founded Apple Inc. in 1976 with business partner Steve Jobs, which went on to become the world's largest information technology company by revenue and the world's largest company by market capitalization.
 
• **Mark Elliot Zuckerberg**, the chairman, chief executive officer, and controlling shareholder of Facebook, is most known for co-founding the social networking website Facebook and its parent company Meta Platforms.
